facts.text: Founded in 1782 as the Bank of San Carlos, it became the Bank of Spain in 1856 after two renamings.
From 7 to 9 January 2021, Madrid received its heaviest snow since 1904, with up to 60 cm falling across the city.
Madrid is a major film and television production hub, employing 19,000 people locally and hosting headquarters of RTVE, Atresmedia, Mediaset España, and Movistar+.
Real Madrid, founded in 1902, plays La Liga matches at Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, one of the world’s largest football arenas.
Madrid Dome in Antarctica’s Aristotle Mountains is named after the Spanish capital, linking the city to a remote polar landmark.
Madrid’s Golden Triangle of Art on Paseo del Prado houses the Prado, Reina Sofía, and Thyssen‑Bornemisza museums, a trio of world‑class art collections.
